content.heading: Elevate Your

content.heading: Grzegorz Strzeszewski
content.description: I build modern web applications using the latest technologies. I specialize in React, Node.js and databases, approaching UX/UI with a futuristic mindset and creating scalable solutions from frontend to backend.

About.title: Some words about me
About.description: I am a fullstack developer with over 3 years of experience in creating scalable systems. My approach focuses on creating clean, maintainable code and optimizing performance across the entire stack.

interior.title: Passion for Innovation
interior.description: I'm driven by the thrill of turning complex problems into elegant solutions. Every project is an opportunity to push boundaries and explore new possibilities in web development.

exterior.title: Continuous Learning
exterior.description: The tech world evolves rapidly, and so do I. I'm always experimenting with new frameworks, attending conferences, and contributing to open-source projects to stay ahead of the curve.

design.title: Quality Over Speed
design.description: While I appreciate fast delivery, I never compromise on code quality. Clean, well-documented, and maintainable code is my standard, ensuring long-term success for every project.

decoration.title: Client Success Focus
decoration.description: Your success is my success. I take time to understand your business goals and translate them into technical solutions that drive real value and growth.

planning.title: Future-Ready Solutions
planning.description: I build applications that not only meet today's requirements but are also prepared for tomorrow's challenges. Scalability, performance, and maintainability are built into every solution.

execution.title: Collaborative Approach
execution.description: I believe in working closely with clients and teams to deliver exceptional results. Clear communication, regular updates, and transparent processes are key to successful project delivery.

Skills.title: My Technical Expertise
Skills.description: Comprehensive overview of my technical skills and proficiency levels across different technology domains

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.description: Modern React applications with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS
frontend.hoverDescription: Transform your ideas into stunning, interactive web applications. I create pixel-perfect UIs that not only look amazing but also provide seamless user experiences across all devices. From complex state management to smooth animations, I ensure your frontend is both beautiful and performant.
frontend.hoverSubDescription: Ready to build your next amazing frontend? Let's create something extraordinary together.

backend.title: Backend Development
backend.description: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Python, Flask, GraphQL, JWT, OAuth2
backend.hoverDescription: Architect and develop powerful server-side solutions that scale with your business. I design RESTful APIs, implement real-time features with WebSockets, and ensure your backend can handle thousands of concurrent users while maintaining security and performance.
backend.hoverSubDescription: Need a robust backend for your application? Let's architect the perfect solution.

database.title: Databases
database.description: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL, TypeORM, Prisma
database.hoverDescription: Design and optimize database solutions that power your applications. Whether you need complex relational data with PostgreSQL or flexible document storage with MongoDB, I ensure your data layer is fast, secure, and ready to grow with your business needs.
database.hoverSubDescription: Looking for optimal data management? Let's design the perfect database architecture.

devops.title: Cloud & DevOps
devops.description: AWS, Docker, Vercel, Netlify, CI/CD, Microservices
devops.hoverDescription: Deploy and manage your applications in the cloud with confidence. I set up automated deployment pipelines, configure monitoring and logging, and ensure your applications are always available and performing at their best. From development to production, I handle the entire DevOps lifecycle.
devops.hoverSubDescription: Ready to scale your application? Let's deploy it to the cloud with confidence.

testing.title: Testing & Quality
testing.description: Jest, Supertest, Unit Testing, Code Review, Clean Code
testing.hoverDescription: Ensure your code is bulletproof with comprehensive testing strategies. I write thorough unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests that catch bugs before they reach production. Quality code means fewer bugs, easier maintenance, and happier users.
testing.hoverSubDescription: Want bulletproof code? Let's implement comprehensive testing strategies together.

tools.title: Development Tools
tools.description: Git, GitHub, Postman, ESLint, Prettier, VSCode, GitHub Copilot
tools.hoverDescription: Streamline your development workflow with the right tools and processes. I set up automated code formatting, linting, and testing pipelines that ensure consistent code quality. From Git workflows to CI/CD automation, I help you work faster and more efficiently.
tools.hoverSubDescription: Need to optimize your development workflow? Let's set up the perfect toolchain.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about my work and how I can help with your project

q1.question: What technologies do you use in projects?
q1.answer: I specialize in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js (NestJS, Express) and Python. I work with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis databases and use AWS, Docker and other DevOps tools.

q2.question: Can you work on projects remotely?
q2.answer: Yes, I have experience in remote work and collaboration with international teams. I use modern communication and project management tools.

q3.question: What experience do you have in system architecture?
q3.answer: I have experience implementing Microservices, Event-Driven, Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design architectures. I design scalable systems with performance and maintainability in mind.

q4.question: Do you offer post-deployment support?
q4.answer: Of course! I offer full technical support, system monitoring, security updates and consultations on application development.

q5.question: How long does a typical project take?
q5.answer: Project duration depends on complexity. Small applications take 2-4 weeks, medium projects 1-3 months, and large systems 3-6 months. I always provide a detailed schedule at the beginning of collaboration.
